Caption desk incident 26 | 14:20 closeout
09:05 — Hosts reported that audience captions lagged in the main room. The recording copy still had captions in sync. There was no complaint from either side room.
09:15 — Support found that the audience screen was using the rehearsal feed. We selected the event feed and asked a host in the main room to confirm the timing before changing anything else.
09:22 — The host confirmed that the captions now matched the speaker. We did not touch the recording system.
12:10 — An organizer asked us to add two new names to the caption glossary. Please file that separately as a content request; it is not a recurrence of the timing incident.
14:20 — Mark the timing incident resolved. If lag returns on the event feed, note the room and time before switching feeds. Record the details even if an immediate change restores the captions.

字幕值班事件 26｜14:20 結案紀錄
09:05｜主持人回報主會場的觀眾字幕延遲。錄影副本的字幕仍與發言同步。兩個分會場都沒有投訴。
09:15｜支援人員發現觀眾螢幕使用的是彩排訊號。我們改選正式活動訊號，並請主會場的主持人確認字幕時間，再決定是否另做調整。
09:22｜主持人確認字幕已和講者同步。我們沒有改動錄影系統。
12:10｜一位主辦人請我們在字幕詞庫加入兩個新姓名。請另外登記為內容需求，不是字幕延遲事件復發。
14:20｜將延遲事件標為已解決。若正式活動訊號再出現延遲，在切換訊號前記下會場與時間。即使立即處理後恢復，也要記下這些細節。
